title: Grateful Dead Live at The Warehouse on 1970-02-01
source: Lineage: Source 1 SBD > MSR > C > DAT (Biodtl thru O1(7:27); Source 2 MR > Revox A77 > tube pre (O1@7:27 thru Lovelight); Transfer info: Bottlehead tube tape pre pair Tesla tubes circa 1980  > Apogee Mini Me 24/96 > Apogee Mini DAC monitoring and mastering  > FLAC

ai_review.summary: Soundboard recording (minor early mix hiccups) captures an outstanding benefit show highlighted by a soaring Lovelight with Peter Green and a raging Other One.
ai_review.review: The performance is consistently praised – the benefit show delivers a monster Lovelight featuring guest guitarist Peter Green trading licks with Jerry, plus an incendiary Other One. The soundboard source is generally clear, though reviewers note the first couple of tunes suffer from a slightly off‑balance mix and a prominent Bobby (Bob) in the early levels.

ai_rating.rationale: All five reviewers gave 4–5 stars, emphasizing superb musical moments; recording issues are limited to a brief mix imbalance, resulting in an overall high rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Early portion of the set has a slightly off‑balance mix (Bobby up in the mix) and general mix imperfections, but the rest of the recording is clear and well‑balanced.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Show stretches out with a busy Lovelight that adds length and excitement; banter and occasional teased tunes add character, while the second set builds to a high‑energy Other One.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Trading licks with Peter Green during Lovelight, praised as a favorite Dead moment.
band_member_comments.Phil: Brief Dark Star riff noted before he “had to die,” indicating a quick but memorable contribution.
band_member_comments.Bob: Early mix places Bobby (Bob Weir) prominently in the soundstage.
